description: Replace the existing README.md with a comprehensive version covering the full project, and create updated_joke.md with a joke per steering file rules.
steps: Read the existing README.md at the repo root to understand what's already documented.

Create a comprehensive README.md at the repo root that includes ALL of the following sections: 1) Project title and description (Hotel Booking Application - a full-stack hotel management system). 2) Demo link (preserve the existing YouTube link: https://youtu.be/HBzZPsiOX20?feature=shared). 3) Screenshots section (preserve the 4 existing screenshot URLs from the current README). 4) Tech Stack section covering: Frontend (React 18, React Router v6, React Bootstrap, Axios, Swiper, react-date-range, date-fns, react-toastify, react-datalist-input, react-icons, CSS) and Backend (Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB with Mongoose, JWT authentication, bcryptjs, cookie-parser, cors, dotenv). 5) Architecture Overview describing the client-server architecture: React SPA frontend communicating with Express REST API, MongoDB database, JWT cookie-based auth flow, Context API for state management (AuthContext, SearchContext), custom useFetch hook for data fetching. 6) Project Structure section showing the full directory tree with descriptions of each major directory: root (React frontend), booking-api/ (Express backend), src/pages/ (home, hotel, list, login, register, reservation, city pages for 9 cities: Hanoi, Dongha, Tucson, Budapest, New York, LA, Seattle, Berlin, London), src/components/ (featured, footer, guestLove, header, navbar, propertyList with slider sub-components, reserve, review, searchItem), src/context/ (AuthContext, SearchContext), src/hooks/ (useFetch), src/assets/ (city images, hotel logo, review images), booking-api/api/controllers/ (auth, hotel, reservation, review, room, user), booking-api/api/models/ (hotel, reservation, review, room, user), booking-api/api/routes/ (auth, hotel, reservation, review, room, user), booking-api/api/utils/ (error, verifyToken). 7) Prerequisites section (Node.js, npm, MongoDB). 8) Getting Started / Installation section with step-by-step instructions: clone repo, install frontend deps (npm install in root), install backend deps (npm install in booking-api/), create .env file in booking-api/ with MONGO=<mongodb-connection-string>, JWT=<jwt-secret-key>, PORT=5050 (optional). 9) Running the Application section: start backend (npm start in booking-api/ runs on http://localhost:5050), start frontend (npm start in root runs on http://localhost:3000). 10) API Endpoints section documenting ALL routes: Auth (POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login), Hotels (POST /api/hotels, PUT /api/hotels/:id, DELETE /api/hotels/:id, GET /api/hotels/:id, GET /api/hotels, GET /api/hotels/countByCity?cities=city1,city2, GET /api/hotels/countByType, GET /api/hotels/room/:id), Rooms (POST /api/room/:hotelid, PUT /api/room/:id, PUT /api/room/availability/:id, DELETE /api/room/:id/:hotelid, GET /api/room), Users (PUT /api/user/:id, DELETE /api/user/:id, GET /api/user/:id, GET /api/user), Reservations (POST /api/reservation/:userId, PUT /api/reservation/:id, DELETE /api/reservation/:id/:userId, GET /api/reservation/:id, GET /api/reservation, GET /api/reservation/find/:userId), Reviews (POST /api/review, GET /api/review/:id, GET /api/review/hotel/:id, GET /api/review). 11) Data Models section describing the 5 Mongoose schemas: User (username, email, password, isAdmin, reservations), Hotel (name, type, city, address, distance, photos, title, desc, rating, subDesc, rooms, cheapestPrice, featured, subSearch), Room (title, price, maxPeople, desc, roomNumbers with unavailableDates), Reservation (user, dates, hotel, room, hotelName, roomNumber, hotelPhoto, total), Review (userid, rate, comment, hotelid, username). 12) Features section listing key features: user registration and login, city exploration pages with photos and food recommendations, hotel search by city with price filters, hotel detail view with photo gallery slider, room reservation with date-based availability checking, reservation management (view current/past, cancel current), hotel review and rating system, responsive UI with Swiper carousels. 13) Environment Variables section listing MONGO, JWT, PORT for backend and REACT_APP_VERCEL_ANALYTICS_ID for frontend. 14) Available Scripts section: frontend (npm start, npm run build, npm test, npm run eject), backend (npm start using nodemon). 15) Deployment section noting Vercel analytics integration (vitals.js, .env.production). 16) License section (ISC as noted in backend package.json). 17) Disclaimer (preserve the existing disclaimer about fictional hotel data).
Create a new file updated_joke.md at the repo root with a booking/hotel-themed joke inside it.
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists at the repo root and contains all 17 sections listed in the steps
README.md preserves the existing YouTube demo link and screenshot URLs
README.md documents all API endpoints from all 6 route files
README.md includes the full project directory structure
README.md includes environment variable documentation for both frontend and backend
README.md includes step-by-step setup and running instructions
updated_joke.md exists at the repo root and contains a joke
